# Anuraag Burman — Product Manager Portfolio

> Senior Product Manager at Delivery Hero / Foodpanda, Singapore. 10+ years building subscription products, fintech systems, and AI-powered tools across 15+ APAC and EU markets.

## About
Anuraag Burman is a product leader and Super IC on the Subscriptions team at Delivery Hero / Foodpanda. He owns product strategy, execution, and cross-functional delivery for subscriptions across 15+ markets. His career spans architecture, e-commerce co-founding ($12M revenue), fintech, coliving, and food delivery at scale.

## Key Achievements
- $150M+ GMV subscription P&L ownership
- 36% churn reduction through pricing and benefit optimization
- Conversion uplift from 8% to 38% via 1-click enrollment and free trials
- 12% support cost reduction via AI knowledge base (Vertex AI)
- Wallet strategy: 3% to 27% order share, $30M GMV in 2 months
- EUR 60M cost savings through incentive audience targeting
- 99.8% payment success rate
- Partner integrations: Spotify, TADA, LineGo, Bolt

## AI Building Experience
- PortfolioIQ: Full-stack AI stock intelligence app (Next.js, Supabase, Claude API, Vercel)
- TR Knowledge Base: Enterprise RAG pipeline (Vertex AI Search, Auth0, Google Cloud) — shipped to production, serves all markets
- Waypoint.ai: Component-based frontend using 21st.dev
- Quiz App: No-code AI tool evaluation (Lovable, Replit)
